adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6`, `basePath` now checks `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1`. In JavaScript, `String#replace` without a global regex only replaces the first underscore, so a type like `foo_bar_baz` would become `foo-bar_baz` and fail to match an `ADMIN_MODELS` entry like `foo-bar-baz`, incorrectly routing it to `/` instead of `/admin/`. The finding’s broader claim about identity-map/model lookups being “split across two type keys” is not directly verifiable from this diff, but the partial underscore-to-dash conversion behavior is a concrete, diff-grounded defect.
